theorems.statement: ∀ P : ℕ, (∀ (k m n' : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) (h : n' = k + m), ∃ flat : Covector (Euclid P) n' →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) m, ∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n') (v : Fin m → Euclid P), flat α v = α (Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h)) ∧ ∀ (a b : ℕ) (flat : Covector (Euclid P) a →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) b) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) a) (t : Euclid P), IsTestForm ω → IsTestForm (fun y => flat (ω (t + y))) ∧ tsupport (fun y => flat (ω (t + y))) ⊆ (fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' tsupport ω
